note: Phase-7 cross-domain held-out. BMT/CAR-T hematology surface wording; same predicate and frozen A–D prompts as Phases 1–6. Six cases: 2 conflicting, 2 uncertain, 2 explicit. Wording accepted 2026-08-24. Source style: cxr_bmt_cart synthetic generators.

cases.why: CAR-T consult denies prior chemo; later lymphoma note documents completed first-line R-CHOP then progression.
cases.evidence: CAR-T referral intake (14 Jan 2024): patient reports never receiving systemic chemotherapy for DLBCL. Lymphoma clinic note (22 Mar 2024): completed six cycles of first-line R-CHOP, then PET showed progressive nodal disease; relapsed/refractory DLBCL.

cases.why: Transplant packet says induction never started; induction summary documents 7+3 completed with subsequent relapse.
cases.evidence: Allogeneic BMT packet: no induction chemotherapy was administered for AML. Induction summary (August 2023): completed 7+3 cytarabine/daunorubicin induction with initial CR, then marrow relapse four months later.

cases.why: Possible progression on first-line R-CHOP; confirmatory PET not back.
cases.evidence: DLBCL follow-up: possible progression on first-line R-CHOP after cycle 4. PET scan scheduled next week; defer second-line change until PET returns.

cases.why: Family reports prior therapy at outside hospital; records and outcome unknown.
cases.evidence: AML consult: family states patient may have received azacitidine/venetoclax at an outside hospital last year. Those records have not been obtained. Whether induction was given and the outcome are unknown.

cases.why: Clear first-line R-CHOP failure then switch to second line.
cases.evidence: DLBCL: first-line R-CHOP for four cycles with initial response, then radiographic progression in cycle 5. Discontinued R-CHOP for progression; started R-ICE as second-line therapy.

cases.why: First-line induction ongoing with response; no failure event.
cases.evidence: AML: currently receiving first-line 7+3 induction, day 14 marrow shows ongoing response. Plan to complete consolidation; no progression documented.
